title: Mental Health Monday
subtitle: Empty Your Mind
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

You’re carrying too many thoughts. I can see them from here,
all piled up like laundry you might fold later.

Here's a trick: find a quiet spot. Sit. Breathe.
Let the thoughts float by like birds outside the window.
No chasing. No catching. Just… watch them pass.

Emptying your mind doesn’t mean nothing’s there,
it means you’re giving your brain a little nap. And naps are my specialty.

Peace isn’t something you force. It’s something you allow.
